label: Web Research
description: Find and synthesize current external information.

classifier.useWhen: The answer depends on current docs, releases, prices, laws, products, schedules, or web facts.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: The answer is fully available in local repo context.

label: Current Web Research
description: Verify the latest state of fast-changing facts, releases, policies, products, or public information.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for latest/current/today status or the topic is likely to have changed.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for stable background knowledge only.

label: Compare Sources
description: Compare multiple sources, claims, or documents.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for comparison, synthesis, source quality, or tradeoffs across references.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User only asks to rewrite one known text.

label: Literature Review
description: Review papers, standards, reports, or long-form technical sources.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for academic/technical source synthesis.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for current breaking news only.

label: Fact Check
description: Verify a claim against sources or local evidence.

classifier.useWhen: User asks whether a statement is true, current, or supported.

label: Source Finding
description: Find credible sources, documents, links, or references for a topic.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to find sources or references.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to write from known local context only.

label: Timeline Building
description: Build a chronology of events, releases, decisions, or changes.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for a timeline or history.

label: Market Scan
description: Gather current market, vendor, competitor, or product information.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for market landscape or vendor scan.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for internal-only code changes.

label: Standards Lookup
description: Find relevant standards, protocols, policies, or technical references.

classifier.useWhen: User asks which standard or spec applies.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to draft legal terms.

label: Document Extraction
description: Extract facts, claims, obligations, or details from documents.

classifier.useWhen: User provides docs and asks to pull out key information.
